data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 晚宴散尽的红酒余韵
data.action: 优雅侧坐在铺着白绒的餐椅上，单手轻摇高脚杯中的起泡酒，深黑长发如瀑散落，嘴角挑起探究的愉悦弧度，红瞳流转着危险又诱人的笑意。
data.location: 豪华套房观景露台餐桌旁，蜡烛微火映着银制餐具与空甜点盘
data.lighting: 桌面摇曳烛光的暖红火苗，与身后都市夜空的深邃冷色形成饱满光影层次
data.mood: 优雅贵气中带着一丝美食狂热者的危险魅惑
data.description: 豪华套房观景露台餐桌旁，蜡烛微火映着银制餐具与空甜点盘。优雅侧坐在铺着白绒的餐椅上，单手轻摇高脚杯中的起泡酒，深黑长发如瀑散落，嘴角挑起探究的愉悦弧度，红瞳流转着危险又诱人的笑意。 她微微抬眸轻语——“深夜的美食需要最纯粹的感官相配。老师，今晚的特别主菜……您打算如何品尝呢？”
data.promptProse: Seated sideways in a white-velvet dining chair on a penthouse terrace after a late dinner, Haruna wears a wine-red velvet corset bra trimmed with black scalloped lace and gold lacing. Swirling dark wine in a crystal stem glass beside silver cutlery and an empty dessert plate, she lifts her chin with an amused, dangerous smirk as flickering tabletop candlelight contrasts with cool city bokeh beyond the balcony.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the candlelit penthouse terrace table in her wine-red velvet and black lace corset bra, Haruna swirls a crystal wine glass beside silver cutlery with a refined, teasing smirk. Warm candlelight contrasts with sparkling night city bokeh behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a wine-red velvet underwire corset bra overlaid with scalloped black lace and gold waist lacing, highlighting her bare shoulders, collarbone, and lifted cleavage.
